---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Consolidated Net Durable Intangible Capital with Cash-Earnings Floor
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), ADD(TS_SUM(DELTA(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), 1), 5), dlc)), at)), IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(ib, dp), at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: Durable intangible productivity is five years of self-built knowledge investment, less the same five years of purchased intangible additions and the debt falling due next year, all validated by a cash-earnings floor that never collapsed over the same window.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This assembles the three separately validated ingredients on a common five-year horizon: the flow-form intangibles penalty (gen-7 build-minus-buy, fmb 5.86, alpha 4.4%), the short-term-debt deduction (Net Durable Intangible Capital, ls_talpha 4.51), and the income-statement floor that lifts coverage from 0.084 to 0.141 without losing alpha (gen-6, alpha 3.8%, ls_talpha 3.47). It is the natural end-point of this line and should be judged against its parents on whether it holds fmb near 5 and ls_talpha near 4.5 at roughly 0.14 coverage.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Research Intensity with Cash-Denominated Deal Premium
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), ADD(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), TS_SUM(oancf, 5))))))
HYPOTHESIS: A firm builds durable intangible productivity when it invests heavily in its own research while carrying a purchased-intangible balance that is small measured in years of its own cash generation, rather than small measured against its asset base.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The cash-denominated deal premium delivered the archive's best Sharpe (0.505) and a 4.8% alpha but an essentially zero Fama-MacBeth slope, because the measure is compressed near zero for the majority of firms with little goodwill; conjoining it with research intensity restores cross-sectional dispersion exactly where the compression occurs. This is the one pairing that could combine the highest-Sharpe intangibles measure with a slope, and it tests whether cash-denomination beats asset-denomination of the goodwill penalty inside the winning conjunction.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Acquisitive Expansion Without an Earnings Floor
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(DELTA(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), 1), 5), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(ib, dp), at), 5))))
HYPOTHESIS: The clean short position is the firm that spent five years enlarging its purchased intangible base while never establishing a cash-earnings floor: the balance sheet grew in unverifiable assets exactly where operating performance failed to support them.
EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: The archive's two best short-side results — the buy-versus-build conjunction (fmb −4.50, alpha −3.2%) and the impairment overhang (alpha −3.9%, ls_talpha −3.42) — each achieved only one of slope or alpha, and both were constrained either by the oancf history or by a one-sided kink. Pairing the five-year acquisitive flow with the negated income-statement floor gives a well-populated short leg at roughly 0.14 coverage and provides the short-side counterpart to Signal 1 for the final round.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Freshness of the Knowledge Stock
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(xrd, TS_SUM(xrd, 5))), IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(ib, dp), at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: Knowledge capital depreciates fast, so what matters is vintage: a firm whose current-year research is a large share of its five-year cumulative research has a live, growing program, while a low share means the stock is stale and its embedded productivity is already in prices.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Every archived intangibles leg measures the size or origin of the knowledge stock, never its age, yet an economics of obsolescence implies two firms with identical R&D-to-assets differ sharply if one is ramping and the other is winding down — and the ratio is self-normalising, so it is free of the size and industry tilts that R&D intensity carries. This is the batch's exploratory slot; it uses raw xrd so that non-reporters are excluded rather than mislabelled as stale, at the cost of coverage near 0.05.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Acquisitiveness Penalty Alone at Full Coverage
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(TS_SUM(DELTA(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), 1), 5), at))), IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(ib, dp), at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: If the entire durable-intangible result is driven by avoiding recent acquisitive expansion in the presence of a stable earnings floor, then the research term is decorative and the simpler two-ingredient signal should match the fuller construct.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Signal 1 bundles research, acquisitiveness and debt maturity, so without an ablation we cannot tell the final round which components are load-bearing; this is that ablation, holding the floor and the coverage level fixed and deleting the R&D and dlc terms. The gen-3 evidence that the goodwill-light leg alone matched the organic-minus-acquired leader (alpha 5.0% versus 4.9%) makes a null result here genuinely plausible and therefore informative.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Worst-Year Cash Earnings on Penalized Capital at Full Coverage
EXPRESSION: IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(ADD(ib, dp), COALESCE(xrd, 0)), ADD(at, ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)))), 5))
HYPOTHESIS: In its worst year, a firm's pre-research cash earnings measured against a capital base that charges twice for purchased intangibles reveals whether its deployed capital genuinely works, with no reliance on a cash-flow statement that only exists after 1988.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The oancf version of this floor-inside-ratio construct produced fmb 4.19 with alpha 3.9% but was stuck at 0.091 coverage, and gen-6 showed the income-statement cash-earnings proxy preserves the economics while reaching 0.142; combining the two findings tests whether the single-leg, no-splice functional form can deliver both a strong slope and a strong alpha on the broad sample. As the only proposal here with no ranked conjunction, it also serves as a robustness check that the archive's results are not an artefact of the MIN structure.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio

---CRITIQUE Consolidated Net Durable Intangible Capital with Cash-Earnings Floor---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: This is a near-duplicate of the archived gen-7 "Net Durable Intangible Capital Behind a Cash-Earnings Floor," differing only in swapping the stock of purchased intangibles for its five-year flow (a change already tested in the gen-7 build-minus-buy signal), so it is a mechanical recombination of validated parts rather than a new economic mechanism, and the arbitrary dollar-for-dollar netting of dlc against R&D remains unmotivated.

---CRITIQUE Research Intensity with Cash-Denominated Deal Premium---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The diagnosis (zero FMB slope from compression near zero) is sensible and the pairing is new, but the second leg is numerically fragile because TS_SUM(oancf,5) can be negative or near-offsetting, making the ratio non-monotone and capable of ranking distressed cash-burners at the top — precisely the population the R&D-intensity leg selects — so the conjunction may amplify rather than fix the leg's defect.

---CRITIQUE Acquisitive Expansion Without an Earnings Floor---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The joint-failure corner (heavy five-year intangible build plus no cash-earnings floor) is a genuinely different quadrant from the archived gen-6 "Recent Deal Flow" positive-corner signal and the sign is internally consistent with the MIN construction, though both legs individually are close to the well-known asset-growth and profitability anomalies, so incremental content over a simple asset-growth/profitability double sort is uncertain.

---CRITIQUE Freshness of the Knowledge Stock---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: Vintage of the knowledge stock is the one dimension the archive has never measured and the ratio is cleanly self-normalising, but the reviewer should note it is close to the published R&D-increase anomaly (Eberhart–Maxwell–Siddique) and that 0.05 coverage plus a mechanically bounded denominator will limit dispersion, so treat a strong result with appropriate caution.

---CRITIQUE Acquisitiveness Penalty Alone at Full Coverage---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This is the archived gen-6 "Recent Deal Flow Versus Legacy Intangible Stock" with the oancf floor swapped for the ib+dp floor already validated in gen-6, i.e. two archived components joined by a substitution whose effect is known, so the ablation is only weakly informative and near-certain to reproduce prior results.

---CRITIQUE Worst-Year Cash Earnings on Penalized Capital at Full Coverage---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: A one-input proxy swap (oancf → ib+dp) on the archived gen-6 "Worst-Year Pre-Research Return on Penalized Capital" is exactly the cosmetic coverage-extension variant the objective warns against, and the double-charging of goodwill in the denominator is an arbitrary weighting inherited unexamined from the parent.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Never-Heavy Purchased Intangible Balance Sheet
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(TS_MAX(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), at), 5))), IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(ib, dp), at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: The current purchased-intangible balance is contaminated by survivorship: a firm that just impaired its goodwill looks intangible-light today precisely because the deal failed, so the honest measure is the worst (highest) intangible burden the firm carried over five years, and only firms that were never heavy deserve the credibility premium.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
REASONING: Every archived intangibles leg reads the current stock or the recent flow, both of which mechanically reward firms that wrote intangibles off, which is exactly the population the impairment story says should be penalised; the five-year maximum removes that contamination and is a new economic correction rather than a recombination. Pairing it with the income-statement cash-earnings floor keeps coverage near 0.14, and if the alpha rises relative to the current-stock version we learn the archive's leading result has been diluted by post-impairment firms sitting in the long leg.

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Deal Premium in Years of Gross Profit
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), MA(SUB(revt, cogs), 3)))), IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(ib, dp), at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: The payback horizon of a firm's purchased intangibles is best expressed in years of gross profit — the surplus actually available to recover a deal premium — and a premium that would take many years of gross profit to earn back is unrecoverable regardless of how small it looks against total assets.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio
REASONING: This keeps the cash-denomination insight that produced the archive's best Sharpe (0.505) while replacing the fragile five-year cumulative operating cash flow denominator, which can be negative or near zero and would rank distressed cash-burners at the top, with gross profit, which is positive for virtually every operating firm and therefore monotone. Conjoining with the cash-earnings floor supplies the cross-sectional dispersion the standalone cash-denominated measure lacked (fmb −0.08) and holds coverage near 0.14 rather than the 0.09 of oancf-based versions.

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Intangible Lightness with Stable Cash Margins
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), at))), IND_RANK(NEG(VOL(RATIO(ADD(ib, dp), revt), 5))))
HYPOTHESIS: The economic story specifies stable cash flows, and the right stability measure is the variability of the cash margin a firm earns on each dollar of revenue — a product-market property — rather than the variability of cash flow scaled by assets, which mixes margin stability with balance-sheet composition.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
REASONING: The asset-scaled volatility version worked (alpha 4.0%, fmb 3.28) but was restricted to coverage 0.081 by the oancf history, whereas the cash-margin version is computable from the income statement for the full sample and isolates operating predictability from leverage and asset intensity. It replaces an uninformative ablation with the one second-moment channel the archive has not tested, and it directly discriminates whether "stability" in the mandated story is a margin phenomenon or a balance-sheet phenomenon.

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Worst-Year Return on Capital Charged for Deal Outlays
EXPRESSION: IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(ADD(ib, dp), COALESCE(xrd, 0)), ADD(at, TS_SUM(DELTA(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), 1), 5))), 5))
HYPOTHESIS: A firm should be charged for the cash it actually committed to buying intangible capital during the measurement window, so the capital base is assets plus the five years of purchased-intangible additions, and the test is whether pre-research cash earnings cleared that base even in the worst year.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio
REASONING: This replaces the arbitrary double-charging of the legacy intangible stock — inherited unexamined from the parent construct — with a principled charge equal to the deal outlays made inside the same five-year window over which the floor is computed, so numerator and denominator refer to one consistent period. It is a single-leg construct with no rank splice, buildable from the income statement and balance sheet at roughly 0.14 coverage, and it isolates whether the acquisitiveness penalty works through the capital base of a productivity ratio rather than as a separate ranked screen.
